spiritgiven.comments: It was a very good communication on and outside the field:)

Regarding the travel calls: There were increasingly frequent travel calls when the scores were close. When making these calls, it would be helpful to be clear about who is traveling and how. Overall, the team was very spirited, and after discussing this with the spirit captain, the situation improved. :)
Such a nice game! We loved your vibes and how you listened to us during the calls!

Great game! excellent communication with the spirit captain of the Team of Australia. Your commitment to fair play was outstanding, and demonstrated a strong awareness of the spirit of competition,making the game enjoyable and respectful for everyone involved.

The definitions of "Double Team," "Travel," and "Marking Infraction" are not very clear (e.g., Double Team: within three (3) meters without also guarding another offensive player). Additionally, when calling a travel violation, it was not clearly explained how the traveling occurred, which we believe needs to be expressed more clearly. There was also a noticeable lack of patience when resolving the call. when indicating a foul, there were no hand signals used.and sideline distance.

1.Fair-mindedness (Calling a double even when we are still far away from the disc)
2.Communication  (Sideline and supporters making unfriendly remarks, with no improvement even after communicating with the spirit captain)

Angel was great at communicating effectively and quickly when a spirit issue occurred. They also kept positive attitudes through all the game which was also appreciated.Thank u guys for bring this spirited game!:)
Congrats!!For Fair-mindedness :There are some guiding calls from the sideline, and for stall outs, signals should be made as soon as possible.

spiritreceived.comments: There were a lot of high fives and great spirts.

Main issues - travels, not dropping with double team calls, multiple interjections from sideline when perspective not asked, not adherent to time limits - coach told players to continue with discussions despite 3 whistles for time limit reached (?to try and expend more time even with just a travel call). 

Discussion with their spirit captains before and at half time, however minimal improvement seen.
It felt like there was a mismatch between the contact our opponents were willing to receive and the contact our opponents were initiating.

Thank you for the game. As we mentioned in the circle, we thought there was a general lack of knowledge of rules, which slowed the game multiple times. We also felt that the players were not very attentive during calls and took the opportunity to talk about strategy during the resolution time.

We felt that the repeated marking infractions (double teams) were persistent even after feedback, and there was no noticeable adjustment to this. We also had to call multiple violations which we felt stopped flow. This was consistent and occurred multiple times per point throughout. We felt stoppages were used to discuss tactics. Happy to discuss further if needed

There were multiple instances of fouls and body contact, especially when they were cutting (pushing our players to make the cuts). Feedback was given and some improvements were made but the fouls and body contact were still more than we appreciated.

There were instances where we felt they could have communicated with their teammates more positively.

A few players did not seem open to our perspectives and insisted on their perspectives. Hopefully that will be worked on for future games :)
Thank you for this game, it was once again very intense. Thank you for having this conversation before the game, we felt that both team were willing to learn and to have a very spirited game.

There were multiple instances of mocking on the sidelines (mainly by their coach) when calls were made and instances of eye-rolling.

There were also multiple instances where our players felt their team was not open to our perspectives. 

It was overall an intense game, and their high spirits on the sidelines was commendable :)
